name: 背景説明と親目標・関連作業の接続領域
prompt: Recreate only the Asana goal description and relationship sections in the primary crop. The source region is 1168 × 437 px, about 2.67:1. Use a plain white page section with no card borders, background panel, modal, or added outer padding. Align all content to the same left edge. At the top, show a dark bold heading 「説明」, then the smaller muted placeholder 「目標の背景を追加します。なぜ重要ですか？何をもって成功としますか？」. Preserve the large open white gap beneath this line before the next section. Lower down, show a bold heading 「親の目標」 and a muted inline plus action 「＋ 親の目標を接続」. Farther down with the same generous vertical spacing, show a bold heading 「関連する仕事」 and the muted inline plus action 「＋ 関連する作業、案件、案件集を接続」. Preserve the source's generous blank space and relative vertical positions between all three groups. Keep text small and left aligned in a regular Meiryo-style Japanese UI font, section headers bold, placeholder and connect actions medium gray. Do not add boxes, dividers, illustrations, linked items, or other page content. The primary screenshot controls whitespace, alignment and hierarchy; the Japanese mock supplies labels and localized copy. This is a static raster candidate, not proof of editable fields or working connections.
reviewNotes: All three sections and localized placeholder/connection copy are present in order. The original generous blank spaces and plain white background are retained without cards or dividers. Candidate is 2048x768 (2.67:1), matching the 1168x437 (2.67:1) source region. A small leading margin and approximate typography remain. Native editing and connection behavior are unverified. Agent-reviewed raster candidate only.
